title: Duke's bodyguards Weak Knees and Jonesy
summary: Bigard calls Duke a coward who had a Washington bodyguard called Weak Knees and a valet, Jonesy, and once tricked Bigard into breakfast as his protection.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: And Duke was a coward. He'd do all his dirty work and he'd have a guy, like, in Washington called "Weak Knees," a bad guy, and he'd have him protecting him all the time when he was in Washington.
He had a bodyguard named "Weak Knees"?
"Weak Knees." Yeah, in Washington, D.C. But Jonesy -- Jonesy used to -- his valet, he used to watch after him, too.

At one time he had me -- he tricked me into having a breakfast with him because he thought -- he didn't tell me until after -- he thought this guy was going to come in the restaurant and beat him (up) and so I was supposed to be the bodyguard.
